title: Gbo language
description: Upper Cross River language of Nigeria
extract: The Legbo language, is spoken by Agbo people in Abi Local Government Area of Cross River State Nigeria. It's is spoken by Ekureku, Itigidi, Adadama and Imabana people. Abi Local Government however also have another language known as "Omono" spoken by the "Bahumonos". Legbo and Omono are two different languages but found within the same Local Government.
